title: Ce and Er co-doped TiO2 for rapid bacteria-killing using visible light

nodes.label: Photocatalytic disinfection needs a catalyst that kills bacteria fast under visible/solar light, not only UV
Co-doping TiO2 with Er (NIR up-conversion) and Ce (gap narrowing, carrier trapping) should give rapid visible-light bacterial killing
TiO2 nanoparticles as the photocatalyst host

attrs.reason: known photocatalyst and efficient up-conversion matrix

nodes.label: Substitute Er3+ and Ce3+/Ce4+ into the TiO2 lattice as co-dopants

attrs.role: up-conversion sensitiser (Er) and carrier trap / gap narrower (Ce)

nodes.label: Er 0.25-1 mol%, then Ce 0.1-0.3 mol% at fixed Er, with calcination temperature 700-900 C

attrs.variables: Er content, Ce content, calcination temperature

nodes.label: Sol-gel from titanium butoxide plus Ce/Er nitrates, gelled at 60 C, aged and dried, then annealed 3 h
Er doping adds visible f-f absorption that is strongest at 0.5 mol% Er and falls at higher Er
Er fixed at 0.5 mol% for the co-doped series

attrs.basis_of_choice: best visible absorption and strongest up-conversion emission

nodes.label: Co-doped powders are mixed anatase-rutile; the rutile reflections weaken as Ce content rises
Er and Ce are incorporated in a Ti4+ host with surface hydroxyl and adsorbed oxygen; Ce is claimed as mixed Ce3+/Ce4+
Faceted polyhedral nanoparticles of uneven size fused into aggregates
Band gap falls from 2.90 eV for TiO2 to 2.20 eV at 0.2 mol% Ce, with strongly raised visible absorption
Photogenerated electron-hole recombination is suppressed and interfacial charge-transfer resistance drops after co-doping
Ce 4f/5d levels narrow the gap and trap carriers while Er3+ up-converts NIR into visible light, so more long-lived visible-light carriers are produced

attrs.mechanism_class: electronic band structure and charge trapping

nodes.label: Photocatalytic dye degradation in 60 min rises from ~20% (TiO2) to ~46%, peaking at 0.2 mol% Ce
The separated carriers generate ROS at the particle surface, and ROS oxidise bacterial membranes and kill the cells
20 min of simulated sunlight with Er0.5Ce0.2Ti-O kills ~92% of S. aureus and ~93% of E. coli

attrs.condition: 5000 ppm powder, 20 min simulated sunlight at double solar intensity

nodes.label: Er-Ce co-doped TiO2 is a solar-driven photocatalyst that disinfects rapidly through enhanced visible absorption and carrier separation
Optimum co-doping is 0.5 mol% Er with 0.2 mol% Ce; more Ce lowers the light-driven activity
Ce ions alone damage bacterial cell walls, giving dark killing that grows with Ce content
The XRD panel varies Ce content at one calcination temperature, so the claimed annealing-temperature control of the rutile ratio is not shown
The Er 4d and Ce 3d XPS windows are unresolved noise, so the Er3+ and Ce3+/Ce4+ valence assignment is weakly supported
XRD reflections of the co-doped powders indexed to anatase (A) and rutile (R)

nodes.label: Lower photoluminescence intensity means a slower electron-hole recombination rate and longer carrier lifetime
Ce ions have incompletely occupied 4f and 5d orbitals that introduce intermediate energy levels in the TiO2 gap

ROS such as hydroxyl and superoxide radicals disrupt bacterial membranes and cellular components
Ce ions react with bacterial cell walls and interfere with cellular respiration

notes: Screen-then-choose paper: an Er-only optical screen (F2) fixes Er at 0.5 mol% (b7 -> b8) before the Ce sweep, so the spine carries a PRP -> DES/down_select step. Control branch: dark killing (b20, o18) is attributed to Ce ions alone and contrasts with the light-driven performance. Two audits. b21: the XRD panel F4a stacks three Ce contents at one calcination temperature, while the linked text reads the vanishing rutile reflections as an annealing-temperature effect, which the panel does not show. b22: the Er 4d and Ce 3d XPS panels (F6c, F6d) are unresolved noise with drawn envelopes and dashed markers, so the Er3+/Ce3+/Ce4+ valence claim that carries the Ce-trap mechanism rests on the text. Numbers are read from the panels: band gaps 2.90/2.46/2.20/2.32 eV from the F4c labels (the MatMech block's 3.2 -> 2.4 eV matches neither), degradation ~46% vs ~20% at 60 min from F8, antibacterial ratios ~92/93% from F10c/d. Panel-section defects: the 'definition' caption spans are offset by one panel throughout (F6a is Ti 2p but is given the 'O 1s' span, F10a is S. aureus but is given the 'and E. coli' span), F10d's OCR read the label as (p) against the detector's d, and the OCR cue lines call the d-spacing labels 0.233 nm and 0.360 nm 'scale bars' and type the SAED panel F5e as a micrograph. Lost: Fig. 2 up-conversion spectra (F3, not opened; carried as premise k3), the XPS survey and Ce-only PL of the supplement, and the Raman panel F4d, whose legend is a 700 C series while the XRD is at 800 C.

changes: o13: image_note extended after the judge opened F9a. Neither Nyquist arc closes inside the plotted window, so the TiO2 arc diameter is a lower bound only; the node reads arc size, not a fitted charge-transfer resistance. Type, panel ids and image_support unchanged.

panel_checks.note: F4c carries the four Tauc extrapolations with 2.90, 2.46, 2.20 and 2.32 eV printed beside them, exactly the values and the ordering in the node; the MatMech block's 3.2 -> 2.4 eV matches neither, as the node says.

F6c is the Er 4d window: an unsmoothed noise trace with a drawn smooth envelope and the 168.8 eV label pointing at a single noise spike. The audit is fairly stated: the figure does not resolve the valence assignment the text reads from it.

F9a is the EIS Nyquist panel (not the photocurrent panel the packet definition string names). The TiO2 points rise near-vertically past -Z'' 1.1e4 Ohm while the co-doped trace turns over below Z' ~1.5e3 Ohm, as the node states.

Extra check of the audit basis. F4a carries A labels on the Er0.5Ce0.3Ti-O trace and R labels on the Er0.5Ce0.1Ti-O trace, three traces differing only in Ce content, so b21's 'the annealing-temperature control is not shown' is correct and is a not-resolved finding, not a contradiction.

review.audit_summary: Five audit nodes, at the budget, and each changes the support of a spine claim: b20 with o18 (dark killing ranks Ce0.3 above Ce0.2, the reverse of the light ranking) opens the control branch; b21 with o2 bounds the phase claim b9 because F4a varies Ce at one calcination temperature; b22 with o11 bounds the composition claim b10, which is what carries the Ce-trap mechanism b14. b21 and b22 are both stated as 'the figure does not resolve it', which the crops bear out. Spine is 17 nodes on one connected path b1 -> b18 with two parallel structure/property branches plus the dark-killing control branch; every spine STR/PRP/PRF node has an incoming evidences edge or basis=argued, and every OBS-with-figure edge carries an mm_op that names a real act on that panel. Total 45 nodes is above the 25-40 target, the excess being evidence OBS rather than spine. No panel_id is invented; the packet's panel 'definition' strings are offset by one wherever the caption puts the letter after its description (F3, F6, F9, F10), which the staff already recorded and which the judge confirmed against the images.
